verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Weaviate runs as a multi-node cluster with replication (replication factor > 1) and stores data in shards, with each tenant on a separate shard. A Kubernetes deployment option supports distributed operation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sharding a collection across nodes for horizontal scaling, details on scaling or rebalancing operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-node scaling.
